question: What do Text Color and Text Highlight offer, and what HTML does a pick write?
base:
On desktop the smallest a row can be is the container width times 0.0215. A 1400px container gives rows of 30.1px. On phones rows start at a fixed 24px.

Row height follows the width, so a layout keeps its proportions when the window changes.

custom.how: real mouse and key input in headless Chrome on the word On, 2026-11-04. Nothing saved: Exit Without Saving after every run.

popover.rule: centred under the Text Color button, 6px below, as the Palette tab

map.rule: x is saturation, y is value from the top; a click at 127,120 gives #804040 and hsl(0, 33%, 38%)
map.thumb: 16px, 3px white border, round, inner and outer 1px rgb(118, 118, 118) ring, filled with the color

hue.rule: x over the whole bar is the hue; a click at 60 gives hue 84.47, #668040 from #804040. The thumb centre moves from 11 to 245
hue.gradient: to left, rgb(255, 0, 0) 0%, rgb(255, 0, 153) 10%, rgb(205, 0, 255) 20%, rgb(50, 0, 255) 30%, rgb(0, 102 ... read this far; the rest of the stops are inferred from the look

alphaField.html: no change, solid color; back to 100% on reopen

custom.keepsOpen: the popover stays open after each pick
custom.reopen: reopens on the Custom tab with the color
custom.undo: 2 picks in one edit took 2 undos until Save was disabled again; ours takes 1 for the edit

look.note: Read in edit mode from the page's own frame after each toolbar action, not saved or published: the site's stylesheets are the same, so this is inferred to be the published look. A blockquote first in a block has margin-top 0.
